name: Frost Brand
summary: A weapon that deals extra Cold damage, grants Fire Resistance, and puts out flames.

stats.effect:
When you hit with an attack roll using this magic weapon, the target takes an extra 1d6 Cold damage. In addition, while you hold the weapon, you have {ref:glossary/resistance} to Fire damage.

In freezing temperatures, the weapon sheds {ref:glossary/bright-light} in a 10-foot radius and {ref:glossary/dim-light} for an additional 10 feet.

When you draw this weapon, you can extinguish all nonmagical flames within 30 feet of yourself. Once used, this property can't be used again for 1 hour.
